audit_of.title: SYNTHETIC: Model V outperforms leading systems on contract clause questions

claim.quote: Model V outperforms leading systems on CLAUSE-50 [...] up to 14 points better, with 36 percent fewer errors than System A. [...] Model V is the most accurate system available for contract review.
claim.locator: Headline; What this means for buyers

supporting_result.quote: Model V 41 of 50 (82%), System A 36 of 50 (72%), System B 34 of 50 (68%).

design.locator: What we tested; How we ran it
design.ceiling: One run of three systems on 50 questions written and marked by the vendor can show how these answers were marked on these questions on that day. It cannot rank the systems in general, and it cannot separate the model from the prompt it was given.
